06/08.10.2025 Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned counsel appearing for the State.
2.

The prayer in the petition is made for quashing of the order dated 02.08.2018 whereby the process under Section 82 of Cr.P.C. has been issued against the petitioner in connection with Vigilance P.S. Case No.22 of 2003 corresponding to Vigilance Case No.24 of 2003 registered under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 477(A) and 120(B) of Indian Penal Code and Section 13(2) and 13(1)(D) of Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge (ACB), Dumka.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has not received any summon or bailable warrant of arrest or NBW and by the impugned order straightway process under Section 82 has been issued against the petitioner.
He further --1-- 2025:JHHC:31014 submits that the said order is also not on the parameters under Section 82 of Cr.P.C.
He further submits that the petitioner is not named in the FIR.
He then submits that even the date and time is not mentioned in the said impugned order and in view of that the said order may kindly be set aside.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the State opposes the prayer and submits that the petitioner has not appeared and in view of that the learned Court has rightly passed the order.

5. The impugned order is dated 02.08.2018 and prior to that the order dated 13.07.2018 has been passed by the learned Court wherein it has been recorded that NBW issued against the petitioner is not executed as yet and by the next order dated 02.08.2018 straightway process under Section 82 has been issued.
It has been pointed out that the petitioner has not received any summon, bailable warrant of arrest or NBW and he was not knowing about the fact of the case as he is not named in the FIR.

The mandatory provisions made i.e. date of appearance and time is also not disclosed in the impugned order dated 02.08.2018 and that has been issued in absence of any execution of the notice, summon, bailable warrant and NBW and in view of that the impugned order is not in accordance with law, as such the impugned order dated 02.08.2018 is hereby set aside.
6. The matter is remitted back to the learned Court to proceed afresh in accordance with law.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Dated 08.10.2025 Sangam/
